Math.random.description: The Math.random() function returns a floating-point, pseudo-random number in the range 0–1 (inclusive of 0, but not 1) with approximately uniform distribution over that range.

Math.round.description: The Math.round() function returns the value of a number rounded to the nearest integer.

Math.floor.description: The Math.floor() function returns the largest integer less than or equal to a given number.

Math.ceil.description: The Math.ceil() function always rounds a number up to the next largest whole number or integer.

Math.trunc.description:
ES2015
The Math.trunc() function returns the integer part of a number by removing any fractional digits.

Math.sumPrecise.description:
ES2026
Math.sumPrecise(iterable)
sums an iterable of numbers using an exact algorithm that avoids the rounding error naive `reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)` accumulates — e.g. summing `[1e20, 0.1, -1e20]` correctly yields `0.1` instead of `0`. Returns `-0` for an empty iterable; throws on non-Number values (no BigInt, no coercion).
